text:
Maya K: quick sync — want to lock a short-format webinar (30m) around 'practical inference economics' next month. goal: actionable knobs for infra + product teams. who can speak?
Noah L: i'd volunteer a 10m segment on batching + cache wins. can show 2 customer examples.
Priya S: i can cover model selection + quantization tradeoffs (8–10m). short slides, one benchmark chart.
Maya K: perfect. need a moderator for q&a and a brief customer vignette (5m). Ben R any customer who can do 3m?
Ben R: pinged @Sara M — she might share a short quote and 2 screenshots from onboarding. Sara M: happy to help, can prep a slide and join the panel for 3–5 mins.
Maya K: sweet. next: abstracts. want tight copy for event page and email. two variants: 1) engineering-forward (latency/cost SLOs) 2) product-forward (feature velocity + cost). Priya S: i'll draft both variants today.
Noah L: landing page needs a short bulleted takeaway list — e.g. "1) Reduce token cost via prefix caching 2) Choose quantization by latency SLO 3) Routing policies for failover"
Maya K: run-of-show draft — pls review: 
```
0:00 - Host intro (Maya, 2m)
0:02 - Speaker 1 (Noah) batching & caching (10m)
0:12 - Speaker 2 (Priya) model & quantization picks (8m)
0:20 - Customer vignette (Sara, 3m)
0:23 - Panel Q&A (Maya + all, 7m)
0:30 - CTA + follow-up (1m)
```
Ben R: looks tight. suggest swapping Q&A to 10m if live questions > predicted.
Maya K: rehearsal plan — two dry runs: tech check + script run (one week prior) and full dress (1 day prior). available slots: Tue 10/10 11:00–11:30, Thu 10/12 16:00–16:30. everyone confirm?
Sara M: can do Tue 10/10.
Priya S: Thu works better for me, but i can make Tue if needed.
Noah L: Tue is fine.
Ben R: Thu for me. prefer full dress on Thu.
Maya K: ops-bot: reserve both slots on the webinar calendar pls.
ops-bot: booked — Tue 1724685600 and Thu 1724772000 in #webinar-calendar. invites sent to participants. :white_check_mark:
Maya K: marketing assets — need 1 hero image, 2 social cards, and 1 benchmark chart export (png). Priya can you export chart and Noah will annotate?
Priya S: will export by EOD. Noah L: i'll add annotations and short caption.
Maya K: inbound routing — post-webinar followup should hit: "webinar attendees" list -> MQL bucket -> triggered demo cadence (sales-marketing playbook). Ben R want to own the routing map?
Ben R: i'll draft the routing flow and share in this thread.
Maya K: final: speakers, please send slides (16:9) and 2 talking points each by next Wed (1724689999). short bullets only.
Noah L: noted.
Priya S: noted.
Sara M: sending slide tomorrow."
